author: toketrain
body:
I've been working on a new DTM map for a couple days. The teams are Bees vs. Hornets. I wanted a map with all the stuff I've seen that's popular: TNT, enchanting, and some other good gameplay stuff I worked into it. You can do many methods: bridging in the sky or under the bedrock, rushing (once a path has been set up of course as there are many gaps), fighting your way to the monument, tunneling around, etc.


The honeycombs on the bottom have slime blocks under them so you can bounce, the ones on top have the monuments. There's plenty of space to blow stuff up too.
Best of all, spectators spawn on a giant bee :)
